import std.json as json

export type Provider = (string) -> Result<string, string>
export type Compile = (string, Provider) -> Result<string, string>
export type Process = (string, Array<string>, string, Array<string>) -> Result<int, string>
export type Capture = (string, Array<string>, string, Array<string>) -> Result<string, string>
export type Native = (string, Array<string>) -> Result<string, string>

export record FileMetadata derives JSON {
  path: string,
  bytes: int,
  mode: string,
}

export function fileMetadata(path: string, native: Native) -> Result<FileMetadata, string> {
  json.parseAs<FileMetadata>(native("file-metadata", [path])?)
}

export record CapturedOutput derives JSON {
  code: int,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
}

export const COMPILER_SOURCE_SET = "sha256:4e7ee5fd9ddd3f4f0da7fcacbce5a59ce5786667180b12164d79cfff7ddd3afb"
export const EXCHANGE_SCHEMA = "topaz.compiler.stage1-exchange/v2"
export const VERSION = "topaz-core-kit 0.1.0-dev (canonical Topaz 5.21.2)"

export record DirectoryEntry derives JSON {
  name: string,
  kind: string,
}

export record HostFact derives JSON {
  kind: string,
  mountId: string,
  logicalPath: string,
  status: string,
  source: string,
  entries: Array<DirectoryEntry>,
  aliasClass: string,
  reasonCode: string,
}

export record StandardModule derives JSON {
  identity: string,
  path: string,
  source: string,
}

export record PackageFacts derives JSON {
  buildRole: string,
  externModules: Array<string>,
  externReplayModules: Array<string>,
  externReplayErrors: Array<string>,
  generatedStdModules: Array<StandardModule>,
}

// This is the public Stage 1 exchange, not a second compiler interface.
export record CompilerRequest derives JSON {
  schema: string,
  producer: string,
  compilerSourceSetId: string,
  terminal: string,
  entry: string,
  root: string,
  source: string,
  sourceId: string,
  languageMode: string,
  profile: string,
  facts: Array<HostFact>,
  package: PackageFacts,
  maxSourceFacts: int,
  maxTotalSourceBytes: int,
  maxAstNodes: int,
  maxAstDepth: int,
  maxRawTokens: int,
  maxLayoutTokens: int,
  maxHirNodes: int,
  maxLoweredNodes: int,
  maxDiagnostics: int,
  maxGeneratedRustBytes: int,
  maxFactRounds: int,
}

// JSON record decoding projects the fields this CLI uses. Both diagnostic
// families include these fields; their complete responses remain in the core.
export record Diagnostic derives JSON {
  moduleIndex: int,
  code: string,
  message: string,
  lo: int,
  hi: int,
  notes: Array<string>,
}

export record CompilerResponse derives JSON {
  status: string,
  kind: string,
  diagnostics: Array<Diagnostic>,
  checkerDiagnostics: Array<Diagnostic>,
  generatedRust: Option<string>,
}
